author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before was a ring with a centre dot on a straight stick ending in a bone, reading as a key or a lollipop; redrawn like the reference: a tall oval cut face with the ham body flaring from its top and bottom and narrowing in concave curves into a short shank and a two-lobed bone knob.
omissions: Inner bone cross-section on the cut face omitted (a dot there reads as an eye, and an oval cannot keep 8 from the face rim); rind line beside the cut face merged into the face edge.
